To calculate the average rate of change per unit time of the measurements, we use the standard mathematical definition of average rate of change over an interval, which is the total change in the value divided by the total change in time (from the first measurement to the last).

Confidence level: 100%

```python
def avg_rate(series):
    first_time, first_value = series[0]
    last_time, last_value = series[-1]
    
    rate = (last_value - first_value) / (last_time - first_time)
    
    return f"{rate:.2f}"
```
